metadata.project_name: Retail Store Performance and Shelf Audit Assistant

project_summary.problem_statement: Build an AI-powered Retail Store Performance and Shelf Audit Assistant for regional store managers. Users upload an existing store performance or audit PDF or DOCX along with one or more current retail shelf photos. The system produces a concise one-page narrative executive brief, analyzes shelf images for visible product availability, count, and placement issues, combines report context with current visual observations to identify recurring or important problems, prioritizes issues, and recommends corrective actions for the manager.
acceptance_criteria: Installs without errors
No unresolved imports
No placeholder implementations (scripts/check_placeholders.py exits 0)
No hardcoded/fake data in business logic
Reuse files under agents/reused/ untouched
Every graph node has a real implementation
Every declared integration has a real client and a working health_check()
python main.py --dry-run exits 0 without live external calls
Missing required credentials raise a typed ConfigurationError, never a mock or crash
README instructions are copy-paste runnable and reference files/commands that exist

HTTP request models only require fields the workflow spec needs on every call; route-selectable / optional inputs default to Optional and downstream nodes skip work when absent (never fabricate placeholders)
Every async FastAPI route that calls a sync/blocking function wraps it with await asyncio.to_thread(...)

GET /health exists (matching the app route-prefix convention), calls real integration health_check() methods, returns 200 on success and 503 with a reason on failure — independent of any CLI --health flag
No HTTP route whose path/name implies a narrow action while implementing a broader/different action (omit or correctly implement; no full-pipeline re-run disguised as a stage-specific endpoint)
Multipart/file intake routes take only Form(...)/File(...)/UploadFile parameters — never a Pydantic BaseModel body parameter alongside File/UploadFile (avoids silent 422s)

UploadFile / file-intake paths persist to disk or blob and pass path/URL references (or base64 + content_type if bytes must be returned); never put raw bytes in node outputs, orchestrator state, or HTTP JSON — and run_workflow_from_node's return path applies a _json_safe (or equivalent) strip/reject of bytes-typed values

Intent/analysis routers use LLM classification by default; keyword/regex only on dry_run or LLM failure; ok-per-modality access gates when access control exists; and has_image (or equivalent attachment presence) forces a vision-inclusive route independent of question-text keywords

Azure OpenAI chat completions select max_completion_tokens vs max_tokens via detect-and-retry on unsupported_parameter 400 with per-deployment process cache (optional AZURE_OPENAI_TOKEN_PARAM override) — not by deployment-name matching
Integration health_check() failures surface the real underlying API error, not a generic RetryError / retry-exhausted wrapper
Request-ID middleware is present: UUID (or inbound X-Request-ID) on request state, in structured logs, and in the X-Request-ID response header
Implements validation: Compliance / policy validation
Implements validation: Evidence check before showing results
Implements validation: Insufficient-evidence handling for low-quality images
Implements validation: Conflict handling where current shelf photos override report claims for present conditions
Handles edge case: Blurry, partial, dark, or obstructed shelf photos
Handles edge case: Report findings that conflict with current shelf photos
Handles edge case: Report content and photos referring to different dates or store areas
Handles edge case: Multiple photos showing inconsistent conditions across shelves
Handles edge case: Documents with poor OCR quality or missing sections

assumptions.assumption: All 12 workflow nodes are classified as build because workflow.json reuse_decisions mark every node as build (including shelf-vision-analysis downgraded from planogram_vision_agent_chain) and agents/reused/ contains no seeded packages.
assumptions.reason: Authoritative workflow payload reuse_decisions and empty agents/reused/ directory in the cloned repository.

assumptions.assumption: Document and image upload/storage use local filesystem under data/uploads/{job_id}/ with optional Azure Blob when AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING is configured.
assumptions.reason: integrations_catalog is empty; spec lists upload/storage integrations without mandating a specific cloud vendor.

assumptions.assumption: Azure OpenAI provides both text LLM and vision capabilities for routing, summarization, shelf analysis, synthesis, prioritization, and brief generation.
assumptions.reason: session.json catalog_hints reference Azure OpenAI; spec model_requirements require AI for document and shelf understanding.

assumptions.assumption: Shelf detection operates at brand/category and visible-product level rather than individual SKU identification.
assumptions.reason: spec unresolved_questions list SKU vs brand vs category as open; visible-heuristics-only constraint in spec assumptions.

assumptions.assumption: When some shelf photos fail quality gate, downstream vision nodes analyze usable images only and surface insufficient-evidence flags for rejected images without aborting the entire job.
assumptions.reason: README open question favors partial analysis; spec edge cases include poor-quality photos.

assumptions.assumption: Priority score combines severity (stockout > placement > facings), current-photo evidence weight (highest), recurrence vs prior report, and confidence score from evidence-confidence-check using a deterministic weighted formula with LLM tie-breaking narrative only.
assumptions.reason: spec unresolved_questions leave priority formula open; acceptance criteria require deterministic, evidence-backed behavior.

assumptions.assumption: Corrective actions appear as a concise summary in the executive brief and as detailed free-form recommendations in drill-down output.
assumptions.reason: spec unresolved_questions on brief vs drill-down placement; both outputs are declared in spec.outputs.

assumptions.assumption: When both a report document and one or more shelf photos are supplied, analysis-router selects vision_then_unified and the orchestrator runs document and vision branches concurrently.
assumptions.reason: Primary workflow data_flow and conditional branches in graph; inputs require both modalities.

build_spec.responsibility: Accept report documents (PDF/DOCX) and one or more retail shelf photos, run compliance/policy validation, persist files to storage, assign a job_id, and emit a validated upload package for downstream routing.

fields.name: documents_pdf_docx
fields.description: One audit/performance report as PDF or DOCX; persisted to disk, output carries path reference only

fields.name: one_or_more_current_retail_shelf_photos
fields.description: One or more shelf photo files (JPEG/PNG/WebP); persisted to disk, output carries path references only

fields.name: validated_upload_package
fields.description: Job envelope with job_id, document_paths[], image_paths[], content_types, storage_root, submitted_at, policy_check_passed, policy_violations[]

business_rules: Require at least one PDF/DOCX and at least one image per primary workflow spec
Validate allowed MIME types and max file sizes via policy_validator integration
Never emit raw bytes in output; only path/URL references
Register job in orchestrator state under a UUID job_id
Advisory-only compliance check: block disallowed file types and log policy notes; do not assign tasks
build_spec.error_handling: Return structured validation errors for missing/invalid files; raise ConfigurationError if storage root is not writable; do not proceed to analysis-router on hard policy failure.

build_spec.responsibility: Classify the request into document, vision, or unified processing paths and emit branch flags consumed by the orchestrator for conditional dispatch.

fields.name: validated_upload_package
fields.description: Output from upload-intake

fields.name: documents_pdf_docx
fields.description: Original document reference for modality detection

fields.name: one_or_more_current_retail_shelf_photos
fields.description: Original image references; presence forces vision-inclusive routing

fields.name: analysis_type
fields.description: One of vision_then_unified, unified_only, vision_only

fields.name: run_document_path
fields.description: Whether document-brief-extractor should execute

fields.name: run_vision_path
fields.description: Whether shelf-image-quality-gate branch should execute

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Human-readable routing rationale

fields.name: validated_upload_package
fields.description: Passthrough upload package for downstream nodes

business_rules: Default to vision_then_unified when both document and images are present
has_image (non-empty image_paths) MUST force a vision-inclusive route regardless of text keywords
Use Azure OpenAI LLM classification by default; keyword/regex fallback only on dry_run or LLM failure
unified_only when document present and no images; vision_only when images present and no document
Emit explicit boolean branch flags; orchestrator must skip nodes when branch flag is false
build_spec.error_handling: On LLM failure fall back to deterministic modality detection from file presence; never crash; log routing reason.

build_spec.responsibility: Extract text from uploaded PDF/DOCX via document_extractor integration, assess OCR/extraction quality, and produce a structured summary of prior audit findings grounded in report content.

fields.name: validated_upload_package
fields.description: Contains document_paths

fields.name: analysis_type
fields.description: From analysis-router; node skipped when run_document_path is false

fields.name: report_findings
fields.description: document_id, extracted_text, ocr_quality (good|partial|poor), prior_findings[] with category/description/severity/report_excerpt/page_ref, summary, metadata {store_area, audit_date}

business_rules: Support PDF via PyMuPDF and DOCX via python-docx
Use LLM to summarize prior findings into structured prior_findings[] citing report excerpts only
Mark ocr_quality poor when extracted text is below length threshold or garbled; downstream must treat as low confidence
Report provides historical context only — not authoritative current shelf state
Skip gracefully returning empty prior_findings when run_document_path is false
build_spec.error_handling: On unreadable document return report_findings with ocr_quality=poor, empty prior_findings, and extraction_error note; do not fabricate findings.

build_spec.responsibility: Evaluate each shelf photo for usable visual evidence using OpenCV heuristics and optional vision LLM confirmation; flag insufficient-evidence images before downstream analysis.

fields.name: validated_upload_package
fields.description: Contains image_paths

fields.name: analysis_type
fields.description: From analysis-router; node skipped when run_vision_path is false

fields.name: usable_shelf_images
fields.description: images[] with path, quality_score, usable, issues[], insufficient_evidence; rejected_images[]; overall_usable_count

business_rules: Detect blur, low brightness, heavy obstruction, and partial shelf framing
Mark blurry/partial/dark/obstructed images as insufficient_evidence=true
Allow partial pipeline continuation when at least one image is usable
Never guess shelf content from rejected images
Skip gracefully when run_vision_path is false
build_spec.error_handling: If all images rejected, emit usable_shelf_images with overall_usable_count=0 and explicit insufficient-evidence flags; vision downstream nodes must no-op without fabricating findings.

build_spec.responsibility: Detect shelf row regions and visible product bounding areas on usable images to prepare structured row crops for vision analysis.

fields.name: usable_shelf_images
fields.description: Usable image paths from quality gate

fields.name: detected_rows
fields.description: Per image: image_path, row_index, crop_path, bbox, confidence

fields.name: products
fields.description: Detected product regions: image_path, row_index, bbox, label (brand/category/generic), confidence

business_rules: Operate only on images marked usable
Write row crop artifacts to storage alongside job_id; output path references only
Use row_detector integration (heuristic segmentation default; Roboflow when ROBOFLOW_* env configured)
Detection granularity at brand/category level, not SKU
No-op with empty arrays when no usable images
build_spec.error_handling: Per-image detection failures log warning and skip image; do not fail entire job unless integration misconfigured (ConfigurationError).

build_spec.responsibility: Analyze shelf row crops for visible availability, facings/count, and placement issues using row-aware Azure OpenAI vision reasoning. Build-from-scratch replacement for unavailable planogram_vision_agent_chain catalog package.

fields.name: detected_rows
fields.description: Row crop paths and metadata from shelf-row-detection

fields.name: products
fields.description: Product bounding boxes per row

fields.name: audit_query
fields.description: Fixed retail audit prompt describing visible availability, count, placement checks
fields.default: Identify visible stock-outs, low facings, misplaced products, and empty shelf gaps. Only report what is visibly evident.

fields.name: visual_findings
fields.description: issues[] with issue_type, description, image_path, row_index, bbox, confidence, visible_only=true; row_analyses[]; reasoning; insufficient_evidence_flags[]

business_rules: Detect only visible issues — no planogram reference comparison unless explicitly visible in photo
Process row crops in row_index order mirroring catalog planogram_vision_agent_chain behavior
Consolidate per-row analyses into structured issues with evidence image_path and row_index
Propagate insufficient_evidence when row crop quality is too low
No-op with empty visual_findings when no detected rows
build_spec.error_handling: On vision LLM failure per row, mark row as insufficient_evidence and continue other rows; surface Azure API error text in logs.

build_spec.responsibility: Normalize report_findings and visual_findings into a shared NormalizedIssue schema with linked evidence references from both document excerpts and photo paths.

fields.name: report_findings
fields.description: From document-brief-extractor; may be absent on vision_only path

fields.name: visual_findings
fields.description: From shelf-vision-analysis; may be absent on unified_only path

fields.name: normalized_findings
fields.description: issues[] each with issue_id, source (report|photo|both), category, description, severity, evidence_refs[] {type, path_or_excerpt, row_index, page_ref}, recurrence_hint, timestamps

business_rules: Define strict NormalizedIssue schema used by all downstream nodes
Link each issue to zero or more evidence_refs pointing to photo paths or report excerpts
Accept partial input when only one branch ran
Tag report-sourced issues with source=report; photo-sourced with source=photo
Do not merge conflicts here — defer to evidence-merge-gate
build_spec.error_handling: When both inputs empty, emit normalized_findings with empty issues[] and warning note; never invent issues.

build_spec.responsibility: Merge normalized document and photo findings, align issues by category/location similarity, and enforce current shelf photos as source of truth on present-state conflicts.

fields.name: normalized_findings
fields.description: Unified issue list from findings-normalization

fields.name: merged_evidence_set
fields.description: issues[] with merged issue records, conflict_flags[], photo_authoritative_fields[], report_context_fields[], merge_notes[]

business_rules: When report claim conflicts with current photo observation on present conditions, photo wins and report claim is demoted to historical_context
Flag date/area mismatches between report metadata and photo set
Handle multiple photos with inconsistent conditions as separate sub-issues linked by image_path
Never suppress photo contradictions silently
Preserve both sides in merge_notes for drill-down display
build_spec.error_handling: On ambiguous merge pairs, keep both issues linked with conflict_flag=true rather than dropping evidence.

build_spec.responsibility: Reconcile cross-source evidence, flag material conflicts, score groundedness and per-issue confidence, and gate results that lack sufficient evidence.

fields.name: merged_evidence_set
fields.description: Merged issues from evidence-merge-gate

fields.name: scored_issues
fields.description: issues[] with confidence (0-1), groundedness, completeness, conflict_detected, insufficient_evidence, ready_for_synthesis, evidence_strength, feedback

business_rules: Run evidence check before synthesis/brief generation per spec validations
Downgrade confidence sharply for poor OCR, rejected photos, or single-source weak evidence
Set insufficient_evidence=true when photo quality gate or vision analysis flagged gaps
ready_for_synthesis=false only when zero issues have any evidence
Use LLM-assisted scoring with deterministic floors/ceilings based on evidence counts
build_spec.error_handling: Always emit scored_issues even when all insufficient; include explicit feedback explaining gating decisions.

build_spec.responsibility: Rank scored issues by current shelf severity, recurrence signals from report context, and confidence; emit prioritized issue list and corrective action stubs.

fields.name: scored_issues
fields.description: Scored issue list from evidence-confidence-check

fields.name: prioritized_issues
fields.description: Ordered issues with rank, priority_score, priority_band (critical|high|medium|low), rationale

fields.name: actions
fields.description: Corrective action recommendations keyed to issue_id with action_text, urgency, owner_hint=store_manager

business_rules: Weight current photo evidence highest in priority_score
Boost recurrence when same category appears in report and current photos
Deprioritize issues marked insufficient_evidence
Advisory only — do not create or assign follow-up tasks
Deterministic ranking with LLM-generated rationale strings grounded in issue fields
build_spec.error_handling: When no issues qualify, return empty prioritized_issues and actions with explanatory note.

build_spec.responsibility: Generate a one-page narrative executive brief and corrective action summary grounded strictly in prioritized issues and evidence; no new facts.

fields.name: prioritized_issues
fields.description: From issue-prioritization

fields.name: actions
fields.description: Corrective actions from issue-prioritization

fields.name: brief_draft
fields.description: title, executive_summary (<=400 words), key_findings[], confidence_disclaimer, word_count

fields.name: recommendations
fields.description: Free-form corrective action recommendations with issue_id references

business_rules: One-page narrative first per spec assumptions
Include confidence notes and insufficient-evidence caveats in brief_draft
Summarize top prioritized issues only; reference issue_ids for drill-down
Include concise corrective action summary plus full recommendations array
LLM must not introduce facts not present in prioritized_issues/actions
build_spec.error_handling: When prioritized_issues empty, generate brief stating insufficient evidence and recommended next steps (retake photos, supply clearer report).

build_spec.responsibility: Assemble final manager-facing deliverables: one-page brief, prioritized issue list, issue-level drill-down with side-by-side photo snippets and report excerpts, free-form corrective actions, and confidence/insufficient-evidence flags.

fields.description: From executive-brief-generation

fields.name: recommendations
fields.description: From executive-brief-generation

fields.description: Final formatted narrative brief text

fields.name: prioritized_issue_list

fields.name: issue_level_drill_down_with_side_by_side_photo_evidence_and_report_excerpts
fields.description: Per issue: photo_path refs, crop thumbnails URLs/paths, report_excerpt, conflict_notes, side_by_side layout metadata

business_rules: Side-by-side evidence view pairs photo path/crop with matching report excerpt when available
Surface all insufficient_evidence and conflict flags prominently
Use path/URL references for images in JSON — never embed raw bytes
Apply _json_safe before HTTP serialization
Deliver directly to manager without HITL review step
build_spec.error_handling: Missing evidence artifacts render as explicit 'evidence unavailable' placeholders, not fabricated excerpts.

integration_points.notes: validated_upload_package passes directly; orchestrator stores under WorkflowState.
Orchestrator conditional adapter skips document-brief-extractor when run_document_path=false (vision_only path); must not invoke node or pass empty stub findings.
Orchestrator conditional adapter skips vision branch when run_vision_path=false (unified_only path).

For vision_then_unified, orchestrator runs document-brief-extractor and shelf-image-quality-gate concurrently via asyncio.gather after routing; generation_order is linear but runtime fan-out is parallel.

vision_input_adapter maps detected_rows[] crop_path values to ordered image_paths list and injects fixed audit_query; maps products[] into row metadata for prompt context. Replaces unavailable planogram_vision_agent_chain wiring.
normalization_adapter converts report_findings.prior_findings[] into NormalizedIssue entries with source=report; handles absent input on vision_only path.
normalization_adapter converts visual_findings.issues[] into NormalizedIssue entries with source=photo and evidence_refs pointing to image_path/row_index.
normalized_findings schema is consumed directly by evidence-merge-gate.

drilldown_adapter injects workflow_context from orchestrator state (prioritized_issues, scored_issues, merged_evidence_set, validated_upload_package, usable_shelf_images) because graph stub lists only brief_draft and recommendations — insufficient for side-by-side evidence assembly.
Orchestrator retains prioritized_issues and actions in WorkflowState for drilldown_adapter; not a direct edge in graph but required for final output contracts.

risks_or_gaps: agents/reused/ is empty — planogram_vision_agent_chain was catalog-matched but downgraded to build; shelf-vision-analysis must be implemented from scratch without frozen reuse source to copy.
session.json reuse_decisions mark shelf-vision-analysis as reuse while workflow payload reuse_decisions mark it build — payload downgrade is authoritative for this plan.
integrations_catalog is empty — all integration clients (Azure OpenAI, storage, OCR, row detection) must be designed from spec.integrations list only.
nodes_detail manager-drilldown-output declares confidence_notes_and_insufficient_evidence_flags as type number; plan treats it as structured object — schema mismatch in LaunchPad export.
Graph I/O for manager-drilldown-output omits evidence state needed for side-by-side views — requires orchestrator context injection adapter.
Unresolved spec questions remain open: exact priority formula weights, SKU vs brand detection level, retention/access control for uploaded store documents and photos.
Optional Roboflow row detection depends on credentials not defined in scaffold — heuristic fallback required for dry-run and offline tests.
React frontend scope is minimal in scaffold; full manager UI polish may exceed initial codegen unless scoped to upload + results display only.
Advisory: node 'analysis-router' output field(s) 'reason' are never referenced as inputs by any downstream node.

Advisory: node 'manager-drilldown-output' output field(s) 'confidence_notes_and_insufficient_evidence_flags', 'free_form_corrective_action_recommendations', 'issue_level_drill_down_with_side_by_side_photo_evidence_and_report_excerpts', 'one_page_narrative_executive_brief', 'prioritized_issue_list' are never referenced as inputs by any downstream node.

implementation_prompt.content:
Build a runnable Python FastAPI + React project implementing the Retail Store Performance and Shelf Audit Assistant workflow (session-1785925042706-xpjtx7). Follow generation_order exactly. All 12 nodes are BUILD nodes — agents/reused/ is empty and must remain untouched.

## 1. Foundation first
Create app/config.py loading env vars (AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT, optional AZURE_OPENAI_VISION_DEPLOYMENT, optional ROBOFLOW_API_KEY, UPLOAD_ROOT, optional AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING). Missing required live credentials raise app.errors.ConfigurationError — never mock silently. Implement scripts/check_placeholders.py scanning agents/generated and app/ for TODO/pass/NotImplementedError in business logic.

Implement integrations under app/integrations/ each with health_check() surfacing real underlying API errors: local_storage, document_extractor, azure_openai (with max_completion_tokens vs max_tokens detect-and-retry on 400 unsupported_parameter and per-deployment process cache; honor AZURE_OPENAI_TOKEN_PARAM override), vision_quality, row_detector, policy_validator.

Add Request-ID middleware (UUID or inbound X-Request-ID on state, logs, response header). Add app/utils/json_safe.py _json_safe stripping bytes from dict/list outputs.

## 2. Shared schemas
Define Pydantic models in app/schemas/: ValidatedUploadPackage, AnalysisRouterDecision, ReportFindings, UsableShelfImages, DetectedRow, DetectedProduct, VisualFindings, NormalizedIssue/NormalizedFindings, MergedEvidenceSet, ScoredIssue/ScoredIssues, PrioritizedIssue, ActionRecommendation, BriefDraft, WorkflowFinalOutput. Use these consistently across agents.

## 3. Node implementations (generation_order)

### 3.1 upload-intake (agents/generated/upload_intake/)
Implement run(input) accepting document and image path references. Validate PDF/DOCX + image types via policy_validator. Persist to data/uploads/{job_id}/ using local_storage. Return validated_upload_package with path refs only — never bytes.

### 3.2 analysis-router (agents/generated/analysis_router/)
Implement LLM-based classification into vision_then_unified | unified_only | vision_only with keyword/regex fallback on dry_run or LLM failure. has_image/non-empty image_paths MUST force vision-inclusive route. Emit run_document_path and run_vision_path booleans.

### 3.3 document-brief-extractor (agents/generated/document_brief_extractor/)
Extract text via document_extractor. LLM summarizes prior_findings[] grounded in extracted text. Assess ocr_quality. Skip/no-op when run_document_path=false.

### 3.4 shelf-image-quality-gate (agents/generated/shelf_image_quality_gate/)
Score images with vision_quality integration. Mark insufficient_evidence for blur/dark/obstructed/partial. Continue with usable subset. Skip when run_vision_path=false.

### 3.5 shelf-row-detection (agents/generated/shelf_row_detection/)
Run row_detector on usable images. Output detected_rows with crop_path refs and products with bboxes. Write crops to storage.

### 3.6 shelf-vision-analysis (agents/generated/shelf_vision_analysis/)
Build from scratch (planogram_vision_agent_chain package unavailable). Use azure_openai vision over row crops in order. Emit visual_findings issues for visible stock-outs, facings/count problems, placement issues. visible_only=true on all issues. No planogram comparison.

### 3.7 findings-normalization (agents/generated/findings_normalization/)
Merge report and visual streams into NormalizedIssue schema with evidence_refs. Handle single-branch input.

### 3.8 evidence-merge-gate (agents/generated/evidence_merge_gate/)
Merge issues; current photos override report on present-state conflicts. Flag date/area mismatches and cross-photo inconsistencies.

### 3.9 evidence-confidence-check (agents/generated/evidence_confidence_check/)
Score confidence, groundedness, conflicts. Mark insufficient_evidence. Gate ready_for_synthesis.

### 3.10 issue-prioritization (agents/generated/issue_prioritization/)
Deterministic priority_score using severity, photo authority, recurrence, confidence. Emit prioritized_issues and actions (advisory only).

### 3.11 executive-brief-generation (agents/generated/executive_brief_generation/)
LLM generates one-page brief_draft and recommendations grounded in prioritized issues only.

### 3.12 manager-drilldown-output (agents/generated/manager_drilldown_output/)
Assemble all five final outputs. Use drilldown_adapter injecting workflow_context from orchestrator (prioritized_issues, scored_issues, merged_evidence_set, upload package, usable_shelf_images) for side-by-side photo/report evidence views. confidence_notes_and_insufficient_evidence_flags is a structured object.

## 4. Orchestrator (app/orchestrator/workflow.py)
Register all nodes in registry.py. Execute in generation_order but fan-out document-brief-extractor and shelf-image-quality-gate in parallel when analysis_type=vision_then_unified. Honor run_document_path/run_vision_path skip flags. Accumulate WorkflowState for drilldown_adapter. Apply _json_safe on all returns from run_workflow_from_node.

Implement adapters: vision_input_adapter (shelf-row-detection → shelf-vision-analysis), normalization_adapter (both findings sources → findings-normalization), drilldown_adapter (state enrichment → manager-drilldown-output).

## 5. HTTP API
FastAPI app with GET /health calling all integration health_check() methods (200 ok, 503 with reason). POST multipart /audit/intake using only File/Form/UploadFile params — no Pydantic body alongside files. Persist uploads then run workflow. Wrap sync node calls in await asyncio.to_thread(...).

## 6. CLI
main.py --dry-run validates config shape and runs workflow with fixtures without live Azure calls. run_workflow.py exposes run_workflow() and run_workflow_from_node().

## 7. Tests
